cs.t: This is awesome. I can't tell you how many times in my life I've been sent a photo of a Linux panic bracktrace with the first half missing because the screen couldn't display enough lines... Funny story: on an x86 motherboard with no serial, I recently resorted to using an old 4K monitor with the 4x6 tiny console font to catch a panic (that netconsole wouldn't log for some reason).
